scope: Control-panel navigation, closed-scene callbacks and prompt-bound power confirmation.
changes: Audio Escape returns from application routing before closing the panel.
Closed audio controls reject late UI callbacks while preserving global shortcuts and accepted completions.
Audio scroll state rejects nonfinite offsets.
Power confirmation identifies the exact prompt instead of only the requested action.
Closed Bluetooth panels reject late controls while retaining incoming request observation and accepted cancellation completion.
Bluetooth Forget confirmation captures its original prompt and device.

coverage: Audio nested Escape and root native keyboard declarations.
Audio invalid offsets, closed controls, global shortcuts and accepted completions.
Power same-action prompt replacement, closed prompts, capability retirement and duplicate confirmation.
Bluetooth closed controls, cancelled prompts, fresh incoming requests and Forget prompt replacement.
